facts.fact: 247Malawi reports the Ministry of Lands has launched the Land Information Management System (LIMS) to manage land issues and track land transactions in Blantyre, under the World Bank-funded Digital Malawi Acceleration Project.
247Malawi reports the Ministry of Lands launched the Land Information Management System (LIMS) for land management in Blantyre, to replace paper documents in tracking land transactions.

MWI.note: The World Bank funds the project through the government and no private amount is stated.
